Himanshu Kumar  1 min ago to Tatiana Tikhonova

Hi Tatiana,

SilentShift's demo MP4 can be downloaded here without signing in: https://github.com/himanshu748/silentshift/releases/download/v0.3.1/silentshift-demo.mp4

It is the same captioned 2:30 video as YouTube. It demonstrates synthetic orders and simulator delivery, and predates the CSV addition.

For bonus review, here are the claims and supporting links:

Docker (2):Compose setup and native production.
IPM (2):zpm "install silentshift"; public 0.3.1 archive. The README separates the current manifest readback from the earlier public-install and source-install tests.
Workflow Engine (2):native Workflow coordinator and approve/reject/concurrency execution.
Custom adapter (2):PartnerJSON inbound adapter and executed intake.
Vector Search (2):native VECTOR/cosine precedent retrieval and corpus evidence.
Embedded Python (3):assessment and policy methods marked Language = python, called by the native production process.
Community idea DPI-I-689 (4):idea, Visual Trace recipe and Langfuse comparison. The dedicated association is visible on Open Exchange; qualification remains pending.
First AI Hub bug (2):issue #17, with standalone reproduction and compiler output; vendor and organizer confirmation remain pending.
First article (2):Catching semantic failures in an IRIS interoperability production.
Second article (1):Recoverable human review in IRIS: from approval to one delivery.
Video (3): the downloadable MP4 above and the matching YouTube video.
Questionnaire (1): already submitted; retained confirmation.

The README Contest bonuses table has the complete evidence map and limits. This update covers public 0.3.1. Our locally verified runtime is 2026.3.0AI.154.0 / 154U ARM64. The Java PEX candidate will have a separate follow-up once its source/evidence links are public. We are not claiming an online demo or an Embedded Python bug.

Thank you for reviewing SilentShift.
